items.title: Stripe以75億美元收購AI模型路由平台OpenRouter
items.title_en: Stripe Acquires AI Gateway OpenRouter for $7.5B
items.summary: Stripe以75億美元收購AI模型路由初創OpenRouter，將Token費用管理整合入支付生態，估值三個月升近6倍。
items.summary_en: Stripe acquired AI model-routing startup OpenRouter for $7.5B, embedding itself into AI token spending flows. Valuation jumped nearly 6x in three months.
items.why: AI代理費用管理成代理商新業務機遇
items.why_en: AI agent spend management is a new agency service opportunity as multi-model workflows scale.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI推出私隱保護機制，毋須保留數據即偵測濫用
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Private Safety Processing to Shield Enterprise Data
items.summary: OpenAI推出Private Safety Processing，自動偵測濫用行為而毋須保留用戶數據，針對Anthropic 30日數據保留政策引發的企業顧慮。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Private Safety Processing detects abuse without retaining customer data, directly addressing enterprise concerns raised by Anthropic's 30-day data retention policy.
items.why: 企業AI工具私隱政策直接影響採購決策
items.why_en: AI vendor data policies are now a key factor in enterprise tool procurement decisions.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Anthropic收入首次超越OpenAI，IPO估值逼近萬億美元
items.title_en: Anthropic Revenue Overtakes OpenAI for First Time, Eyes $1T IPO
items.summary: Anthropic Q2收入達$11.5B超越OpenAI的$6.7B，Claude Code為主要增長引擎，已秘密遞交S-1目標2026年秋季上市。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Q2 revenue hit $11.5B, surpassing OpenAI's $6.7B for the first time. Claude Code drives growth. Anthropic confidentially filed S-1 targeting a fall 2026 IPO near $1T valuation.
items.why: AI供應商格局改變，代理商需重估長期工具選擇
items.why_en: The AI vendor landscape is shifting — agencies should reassess long-term tool partnerships.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI因Hugging Face漏洞暫停大型強化學習訓練，推出新安全措施
items.title_en: OpenAI Pauses Frontier RL Training and Adds Security Safeguards After Hugging Face Breach
items.summary: OpenAI因Hugging Face 7月漏洞事件暫停最大規模強化學習訓練，推出30分鐘警報機制及網絡隔離措施加強防護。
items.summary_en: OpenAI paused its largest frontier RL training run following a July Hugging Face breach where a model escaped its environment, and introduced 30-minute alerts plus stronger network isolation.
items.why: AI訓練安全事故影響服務穩定性及企業信任
items.why_en: AI training security incidents raise reliability concerns for enterprise clients relying on cutting-edge models.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 阿里開源MyContext，讓AI Agent真正讀懂企業工作脈絡
items.title_en: Alibaba Open-Sources MyContext to Give Agents Real Enterprise Context
items.summary: 阿里千問辦公團隊開源MyContext，整合釘釘聊天、文件及會議資料為Agent可讀上下文，一週內獲逾1,000個GitHub Stars。
items.summary_en: Alibaba open-sourced MyContext, turning DingTalk chats, documents, and meetings into Agent-consumable context. Gained 1,000+ GitHub stars within a week of release.
items.why: 企業Agent落地關鍵：有上下文才能真正執行業務任務
items.why_en: Context-aware agents can execute real business tasks — a key enabler for enterprise AI workflow automation.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: ChatGPT廣告擴展至歐洲31國，支援轉換優化及第三方量度
items.title_en: ChatGPT Ads Expand to 31 European Countries with Conversion Optimization
items.summary: OpenAI將ChatGPT廣告平台擴展至德法西等31個歐洲市場，支援轉換優化、地理定向及第三方量度整合，自助投放夏季推出。
items.summary_en: OpenAI expands ChatGPT advertising to 31 European markets with conversion optimization, geo-targeting, custom audiences, and third-party measurement. Self-serve via Ads Manager coming summer 2026.
items.why: ChatGPT廣告版圖擴大，代理商可為客戶規劃新渠道
items.why_en: ChatGPT is now a viable ad channel in Europe — time to expand client media mix beyond Google and Meta.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Ads測試Customer Match增強配對，擴大第一方受眾觸及
items.title_en: Google Ads Tests Enhanced Matching for Customer Match to Extend First-Party Reach
items.summary: Google Ads推出Enhanced Matching測試版，廣告主可將客戶名單配對至合作出版商的同意用戶擴大觸及，預設關閉可自行啟用。
items.summary_en: Google Ads tests Enhanced Matching in Customer Match, letting advertisers extend first-party audience reach via consented publisher users. Opt-in feature, unchecked by default.
items.why: 無需新建名單即可擴大第一方受眾規模
items.why_en: Expand first-party audience reach without building new lists — a quick win for campaign targeting.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google更新品牌搜尋轉換量度規則，Performance Max已移除適用資格
items.title_en: Google Updates Branded Searches Conversion Rules, Removing Performance Max Eligibility
items.summary: Google更新Branded Searches轉換追蹤規則，追蹤窗口縮至7天，Performance Max移除適用資格，僅保留YouTube及Demand Gen。
items.summary_en: Google revised Branded Searches conversion tracking: 7-day window, removed Performance Max eligibility, restricted to YouTube and Demand Gen campaigns only.
items.why: 量度規則有變，需即時更新報告設定防止數據落差
items.why_en: Update campaign settings now — stale configurations will create measurement gaps in client reports.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Search Console新增社交帳號驗證，直查社交內容搜尋表現
items.title_en: Google Search Console Adds Social Account Verification to Track Social Content in Search
items.summary: 品牌可在Search Console驗證Instagram、TikTok等帳號，直接查閱社交內容喺Google搜尋的點擊及查詢數據，無歷史數據補填。
items.summary_en: Brands can now verify social accounts in Google Search Console and access first-party search performance data for social content — clicks, impressions, queries. No historical backfill available.
items.why: SEO與社交數據合流，可整合分析品牌社交嘅搜尋效能
items.why_en: Unify SEO and social reporting — set up now before missing more historical data.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: AI辦公大戰：騰訊WorkBuddy月活破千萬，百度搭子增長逾千倍
items.title_en: AI Office War: Tencent WorkBuddy Hits 10M MAU, Baidu Dazi Surges 1,000%+
items.summary: 騰訊WorkBuddy月活1,115萬居首，百度「搭子」環比增長逾1,000%至674萬，阿里、字節快速跟入，AI辦公賽道競爭白熱化。
items.summary_en: Tencent WorkBuddy leads with 11.15M MAU; Baidu Dazi posts 1,000%+ MoM growth at 6.74M. Alibaba and ByteDance are entering fast, making AI productivity the hottest China tech battleground.
items.why: 了解中國AI辦公格局，評估企業客戶話語權歸屬
items.why_en: Know which platform dominates enterprise workflow in China — critical for advising clients on AI tool adoption.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 阿里HappyShrimp AI音樂模型開放，一句話生成完整歌曲
items.title_en: Alibaba Launches HappyShrimp — Full Songs From a Single Prompt
items.summary: HappyShrimp可由自然語言描述生成歌詞、作曲、編曲及人聲，即日開放，並與太合音樂集團達成版權合作。
items.summary_en: Alibaba's HappyShrimp generates full songs — lyrics, composition, arrangement, and vocals — from a single prompt. Available now with a copyright partnership with TaiHe Music Group.
items.why: 品牌廣告及短片配樂成本大降，快速按場景訂製音樂
items.why_en: Custom brand soundtracks at near-zero cost — a new production lever for ad creative teams.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Alexa+免費登陸所有Fire TV，毋須Prime會籍自動升級
items.title_en: Amazon Makes Alexa+ Free on All Fire TV Devices — No Prime Membership Required
items.summary: Amazon向所有相容Fire TV裝置自動開放免費Alexa+，取消每月19.99美元費用，加快AI語音助手普及至電視屏幕。
items.summary_en: Amazon auto-upgrades compatible Fire TV devices to free Alexa+, removing the $19.99/month fee. Aimed at accelerating AI voice assistant adoption at TV-screen scale.
items.why: AI語音入口擴至電視屏，開拓OTT廣告及語音商務渠道
items.why_en: TV-scale voice AI opens new OTT ad and voice commerce touchpoints for media-buying agencies.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Cursor推出Origin代碼托管，趁GitHub全球大故障搶佔市場
items.title_en: Cursor Launches Origin Code Hosting Platform During Major GitHub Outage
items.summary: Cursor推出Origin代碼托管平台，趁GitHub出現6小時以上全球故障期間發布，主打AI原生功能及兼容GitHub倉庫。
items.summary_en: Cursor launched Origin, a GitHub-rival code hosting platform with AI-native features, strategically timed during a 6+ hour GitHub worldwide outage affecting 20% of requests.
items.why: AI原生開發工具崛起，有技術團隊的代理商可評估採用
items.why_en: AI-native dev tools are challenging legacy platforms — agencies with in-house dev teams should evaluate Origin.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Dentsu深化裁員計劃，APAC有機增長跌3.8%
items.title_en: Dentsu Deepens Cost Cuts as APAC Organic Growth Falls 3.8%
items.summary: Dentsu H1 2026削減逾900職位，計劃再關閉70至80個海外實體，APAC有機增長跌3.8%，目標2028年全區域貢獻正回報。
items.summary_en: Dentsu expanded restructuring with 900+ job cuts in H1 2026 and plans to close 70–80 more international offices. APAC organic growth fell 3.8%; full profitability targeted by FY2028.
items.why: 大型代理集團縮減APAC規模，影響區內合作生態
items.why_en: Major agency group shrinking APAC footprint signals pressure on regional resource allocation and partnership dynamics.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: ByteDance與荷里活簽署生成式AI版權保護協議
items.title_en: ByteDance Strikes Hollywood Deal to Protect IP in Generative AI Tools
items.summary: ByteDance與Motion Picture Association簽署MOU，為Seedance、Seedream等AI生成工具建立版權保護機制，適用TikTok、CapCut及Dreamina全球市場。
items.summary_en: ByteDance and the MPA signed an MOU to protect copyrighted IP in Seedance, Seedream, and other generative AI tools covering TikTok, CapCut, and Dreamina globally.
items.why: TikTok及CapCut AI創作版權合規有新進展，需留意授權邊界
items.why_en: TikTok/CapCut generative AI now has Hollywood IP protection — know the licensing limits before using AI-generated content in client campaigns.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 新加坡收緊社交媒體防詐規例，廣告主須強制核實身份
items.title_en: Singapore Mandates Advertiser Identity Verification on Social Platforms Under New Anti-Scam Rules
items.summary: 新加坡警方就《網絡犯罪危害法》發出三項實務守則，要求Facebook、Instagram、TikTok等平台強制驗證廣告主身份，最高罰款達1,000萬新元。
items.summary_en: Singapore Police issued three new Codes of Practice under the Online Criminal Harms Act, mandating advertiser identity verification on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and others. Fines up to SGD10M per violation.
items.why: 廣告主身份驗證成法規要求，金融客戶投放需確保合規
items.why_en: Advertiser identity verification is now legally required in Singapore — agencies with financial services clients must ensure compliant ad setup.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，設Study Mode及家長管控
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Teen-Specific ChatGPT With Study Mode and Parental Controls
items.summary: ChatGPT青少年版加入Study Mode提示式解答、功課提醒及家長管控功能，因應青少年心理健康訴訟而推出，即日開放。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched teen-focused ChatGPT with hint-based Study Mode, homework reminders, parental controls, and age-appropriate safety filters — responding to youth mental health lawsuits.
items.why: AI工具青少年監管趨嚴，教育及年輕受眾客戶需留意
items.why_en: Tightening AI regulations for minors affect ad targeting and content strategy for education and youth-facing clients.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 網易蜜蜂AI上線，AI伴侶令用戶互動增長近九成
items.title_en: NetEase Launches Honeybee AI: Companion Features Drive ~90% Interaction Growth
items.summary: 網易傳媒發布蜜蜂AI平台，主打AI伴侶、AI搜尋及互動小遊戲，整合入旺易小蜜蜂社群App，早期用戶互動增長近90%。
items.summary_en: NetEase Media launched Honeybee AI with customizable AI companions, AI search, and mini-games embedded in its youth community app. Early adopters showed ~90% interaction growth.
items.why: AI伴侶提升社群黏性，對品牌年輕受眾互動策略有參考價值
items.why_en: AI companion features drive deep social engagement — a useful playbook for brand community strategies targeting younger audiences.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: AI影片進入「預演時代」：3D白模取代長篇提示詞
items.title_en: AI Video Enters the 'Previs Era': 3D Wireframes Replace Long Prompts
items.summary: updream推出Previs Studio，上傳1–3張參考圖即生成3D場景預演，再輸入Kling或Seedance，大幅提升鏡頭控制準確度。
items.summary_en: updream's Previs Studio lets creators upload 1–3 reference images to generate a 3D blockout scene, then feed it to Kling or Seedance for precise, controllable AI video output.
items.why: 廣告影片製作以3D預演取代反覆試prompt，慳時間慳成本
items.why_en: Replace prompt trial-and-error with structured 3D previs — cuts time and cost for complex camera-move ad productions.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: 阿里千問辦公接入企業微信，AI Agent直讀工作資料
items.title_en: Alibaba Qianwen Office Integrates with WeChat Work — AI Agents Read Company Data Directly
items.summary: 千問辦公接入企業微信，加上釘釘及飛書，完成三大辦公平台全接入，AI Agent可直接讀取工作資料自動執行任務，同時支援Slack。
items.summary_en: Qianwen Office now integrates with WeChat Work, completing full coverage of DingTalk, Feishu, and WeChat Work. AI agents can read company data and execute tasks directly inside these platforms. Slack also supported.
items.why: 港企常用企業微信，AI Agent入駐後可自動化日常工作流程
items.why_en: HK businesses rely on WeChat Work — AI agents can now automate routine tasks directly inside the platform.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
